rule_fix.replacement_sentence: CODE-SYMBOL - the anchor token occurs at least once as a NAME, attribute, keyword or parameter token (i.e. a tokenize NAME token, matched case-insensitively) inside the checkpoint's cited line range path#Lstart-Lend (or, when the citation carries no line range, anywhere in the cited file); occurrences inside a STRING token, any part of an f-string (FSTRING_START/MIDDLE/END), a COMMENT token, or a docstring - including every continuation line of a multi-line string - do not count. The class is decided per occurrence, never per line: on a line that carries both a string literal and code, only the code occurrence counts. Evidence = the first file:line of a counting occurrence.
rule_fix.consequence: Under this sentence the census is unchanged (all 11 cells re-derived identically); 'raising' stays PROSE-CONNECTOR on the single :67 docstring line, and a third party applying the text to a new anchor no longer needs to ask the author which tokenizer or which granularity to use.
